title: WAW to JFK delay 5h due to thunderstorm
input_text:
Dear Vistula Air Team,

I am writing regarding flight VQ505 from Warsaw (WAW) to New York (JFK) on July 20, 2026. Passenger name: Piotr Wiśniewski.
Scheduled departure was 11:00 with scheduled arrival at JFK at 14:45. However, our arrival was delayed by 5 hours (300 minutes), finally arriving at 19:45. The captain stated the delay was caused by severe thunderstorm and lightning along the transatlantic flight route.
